description: SESMG model scenarios of the study "Indicators for the optimization of sustainable urban energy systems based on energy system modeling is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Christian Klemm, Frauke Wiese (Münster University of Applied Sciences, Europa-Universität Flensburg). This folder contains the model scenarios belonging to the publication " Indicators for the optimization of sustainable urban energy systems based on energy system modeling " (https://doi.org/10.1186/s13705-021-00323-3). The individual scenarios can be executed and evaluated with the Spreadsheet Energy System Model Generator (SESMG) v0.0.4, respectively v0.2.0. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
